title: GoOrganicAfrica Central African Republic calculator-readiness review

administrative_geography.special_note: The 20-unit list comprises 18 administrative prefectures, two economic prefectures and Bangui as the capital prefecture/commune in commonly used administrative listings. ICASEES also publishes seven broad regions; do not mix those regional groupings with prefecture selectors.
administrative_geography.boundary_validation: Official coding/boundary crosswalk still required before historical crop-data joins.

evidence.finding: 2026 maize planting completed in central/southern areas under near-average planted area; northern millet/sorghum planting completed in early July. Harvest timing and access remain affected by weather and insecurity.
evidence.limit: Seasonal outlook, not final crop yield or production observations.

evidence.finding: August 2026 maize market price 514 FCFA/kg in Birao and 257 FCFA/kg in Bangui.
evidence.limit: Market price observations, not verified farmgate prices; market/location/date must remain attached.

evidence.source: World Bank indicator sourced to FAOSTAT
evidence.limit: National cereal aggregate only, not crop-specific or prefecture-specific.

evidence.finding: Published population data for seven broad administrative/statistical regions.
evidence.limit: Useful geography context; not a crop production dataset.

outstanding: official prefecture codes and boundary crosswalk

safeguards: No active profile or formula changed.
No invented crop values, prices or costs.
Market observations remain distinct from farmgate prices.
